title: Accept UPI payments from Indian customers in INR, no Indian entity needed
summary: HitPay's UPI (INR) lets businesses outside India accept UPI from Indian customers in INR: 2% + 1% FX, settled in your home currency, no Indian entity needed.
body_markdown:
Updated 4 Nov 2026


## What’s new


We launched UPI (INR) on 30 Oct 2026. It’s a cross-border payment method: if your business is outside India and you sell to customers in India, they can now pay you in INR from the UPI app they already use, and you get paid in your home currency. Full details are on our[UPI page](https://hitpayapp.com/upi) .


## Why UPI matters if you sell to India


UPI is India’s most-used payment method, with over 400 million users. Customers pay in INR in an app they already use, with no card or foreign-currency step.


## Who it’s for


UPI (INR) is for businesses in Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Australia, the US and any other HitPay market that sell to customers in India. You onboard through your existing HitPay account. It isn’t for businesses registered in India. Good fits include:


-


Education and tuition


-


Travel and tours


-


SaaS and digital services


-


Ecommerce shipping to India


## Where it works


UPI (INR) is online only. You can use it on:


-


Checkout and API


-


Payment links


-


Invoices


-


The HitPay online store


-


The Shopify and WooCommerce plugins

## How to start


1.


Sign up or log in to HitPay.


2.


Go to Payment Methods, then UPI (INR), enable it and submit your documents.


3.


Once you’re approved, in about 5 business days, Indian customers see UPI at checkout.


## For developers


The method codes are upi_01 and upi_02, assigned by provider. upi_02 supports API refunds. See the[UPI (INR) docs](https://docs.hitpayapp.com/payment-methods/upi-inr) .


## Coming soon


UPI recurring payments (Autopay) and INR virtual accounts.


## FAQ


### Can a business outside India accept UPI payments?


Yes. With HitPay’s UPI (INR), businesses outside India accept UPI from Indian customers, who pay in INR. You don’t need an Indian entity.


### Who can use UPI (INR)?


HitPay merchants in every market we serve, including Singapore, Malaysia, the Philippines, Hong Kong, Australia and the US. It isn’t for businesses registered in India.


### How much does UPI (INR) cost?


2% per transaction plus a 1% FX fee. There’s no setup or monthly fee.


### What currency do I receive, and when?


Your home currency, in your HitPay balance on T+5.


### Is there a maximum transaction amount?


No. HitPay sets no maximum ticket size for UPI (INR).


### Does UPI (INR) support subscriptions?


Not yet. UPI recurring payments are coming soon.


### How long does activation take?


About 5 business days after you submit your documents.
